Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatched for Kanpur to Rudrapur Route

Dear Apex Chemicals Team,

Following the breakdown of vehicle UP37RY4295, a replacement unit (UP71AL5892) has been dispatched from our Kanpur hub.
The new vehicle is currently en route to Rudrapur with an estimated arrival time of approximately 9.5 hours.
We are monitoring the shipment closely to ensure timely delivery and will provide further updates as needed.
Please let us know if you have any immediate concerns regarding this adjustment.

Best regards,
Meridian Freight Dispatch
